intents.name: technologies
intents.answer:
**Source:** https://leewaysoftech.com/technologies

Leeway selects the stack after understanding the business requirement: Requirement Analysis → Tech Selection → Effective Implementation.

| Category | Technologies |
|---|---|
| Frontend | React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS |
| Backend | Node.js, Python (FastAPI / Django), Golang, Laravel, .NET Core |
| AI & ML | OpenAI (GPT-4 / GPT-5 APIs), LangChain, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, IBM Watson |
| Mobile | iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), React Native, Flutter |
| Databases and data platforms | PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Firebase, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redis |

Technology page links: https://leewaysoftech.com/tech/react, /tech/nextjs, /tech/vue, /tech/angularjs, /tech/typescript, /tech/tailwindcss, /tech/nodejs, /tech/python, /tech/golang, /tech/laravel, /tech/dotnetcore, /tech/chatgpt, /tech/langchain, /tech/pytorch, /tech/tensorflow, /tech/huggingface, /tech/vertexai, /tech/azureopenai, /tech/ibm-watson, /tech/ios, /tech/android, /tech/react-native, /tech/flutter, /tech/postgresql, /tech/mysql, /tech/mongodb, /tech/dynamodb, /tech/firebase, /tech/snowflake, /tech/bigquery, /tech/redis (all under https://leewaysoftech.com).

### Technology solution areas
- **Web development** – React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript.
- **Mobile development** – React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin.
- **Enterprise software** – CRM, ERP, CMS, workflows.
- **AI and machine learning** – LLMs, NLP, vision, predictive.
- **Data and database solutions** – SQL, NoSQL, warehouses, analytics.
- **API and integration** – REST, GraphQL, webhooks, payments.

### Development approach (8 steps)
Understand the business → Define technical requirements → Select the stack → Plan the architecture → Build → Test and improve → Deploy → Continue to evolve.

### Foundations built in
Secure authentication and authorization, API security, data protection, database security, monitoring, error handling, performance optimization, scalable architecture, backup and recovery, maintainable code. Technical SEO, structured data and mobile-friendly delivery for public-facing sites.

### FAQs (Technologies)
- **Frontend technologies:** React.js, Next.js, Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript, CSS frameworks.
- **Backend technologies:** Node.js, Python, Laravel, Golang, .NET Core.
- **How to choose a stack:** depends on business objective, users, performance, security, integrations, scalability, resources and maintenance.

intents.name: benefits
intents.answer:
1. **Certified security and quality** – ISO 9001:2015, ISO/IEC 27001:2013, CMMI Level 3.
2. **Proven at scale** – 1,500+ clients.
3. **Government-grade trust** – active partnership with the Government of Gujarat.
4. **True end-to-end delivery** – from communication systems to full software builds under one partner.

### Home page FAQs
- **What services does Leeway Softech provide?** AI development, custom software, enterprise software, SaaS, data engineering, business intelligence, CPaaS, web and mobile development, and digital transformation.
- **Is Leeway an AI development company?** Yes: Generative AI, AI chatbots, machine learning, computer vision and AI automation.
- **Enterprise software?** Yes: custom enterprise applications, SaaS products, web apps and API integrations.
- **CPaaS?** Yes: Bulk SMS, Bulk Email, WhatsApp Business API, IVR, SMS Gateway and more.
- **Industries?** Government and public sector, banking and financial services, education, enterprise, retail and e-commerce.
- **Where based?** Founded 2012, headquartered in Mumbai, India.
